Summary: Mobilisation Advance shall be limited to 10% of the Contract value and paid in two stages.

Mobilisation Advance –
This shall be limited to 10% of the Contract value and shall be paid in 2 stages :
Stage 1– 5% of Contract Value on signing of the contract agreement.
Stage 2 – 5% on mobilization of site-establishment, setting up offices, bringing in equipment

Notes: The mobilisation advance is interest-bearing (interest applies to diverted advances at 15% per annum, and general interest provisions apply to the outstanding advance period). Paid in 2 stages of 5% each.
